_description: klt erc supply-connectivity spec for layout/evidence/pll-top-layout/pll_top.gds (gf180mcuD), the assembled top level (issue #297). Declares the gate+conductor stackup Poly2..Metal5 with the vias bridging it, and the five supply nets of design/netlist/pll_top.spice (VDD, VSS, VDD_VCO, GND_VCO, VDD_DIV) so erc.unconnected_net / erc.supply_short can be computed across the whole chip. Run with '--deck gf180mcu'. No ties[] entry; see ties_disclosure.

stackup.name: poly2
stackup._comment: Poly2 (30/0), gate poly; active_layer Comp (22/0). Same as every block-level spec.

stackup.name: metal1
stackup._comment: Metal1 (34/0) via Contact (33/0). 34/10 (Metal1_Label) carries the blocks' own supply pin text in the assembled GDS (VDD 30, VSS 32, GND_VCO 28, VDD_VCO 15, VDD_DIV 1 instances, counted with klayout.db over the flattened top cell).

stackup.name: metal2
stackup._comment: Metal2 (36/0) via Via1 (35/0). 36/10 carries one VDD and one VSS text in the assembled GDS.

stackup.name: metal3
stackup._comment: Metal3 (42/0) via Via2 (38/0). No 42/10 text is drawn in this GDS.

stackup.name: metal4
stackup._comment: Metal4 (46/0) via Via3 (40/0): the top-level signal and supply routing layer (layout/evidence/pll-top-layout/PROOF.md).

stackup.name: metal5
stackup._comment: Metal5 (81/0) via Via4 (41/0): the top-level supply pins. 81/10 carries exactly one text per supply (VSS, VDD, VDD_VCO, GND_VCO, VDD_DIV).

nets.name: VDD
nets._comment: Digital supply of pfd_cp and lock_detector; the netcheck records it as a star of two branches meeting at one pad, i.e. one electrical island.

nets.name: VSS
nets._comment: Shared ground of every block except the VCO.

nets.name: GND_VCO
nets._comment: VCO ground, its own pin; shares the p-substrate with VSS (PROOF.md 'GND_VCO and VSS').

ties_disclosure.reason: The assembled top level draws one Nwell layer (21/0) that holds the n-wells of several differently-supplied blocks (at least VDD for pfd_cp and lock_detector, VDD_VCO, VDD_DIV), and one ties[] entry grades every shape of its well_layer against a single net. Selecting the wells of one supply needs a marker layer to select on (ties[].well_requires / well_excludes) and this stream draws none. Well-tie coverage is therefore not graded at the top level; each block's own erc-report.json grades it on that block's GDS, and the top level adds only the island check across the routing.
ties_disclosure._comment: Machine-readable disclosure of a deliberate zero-ties[] declaration. It keeps T1 item 11 UNMET for the top level (the caller's word is not a computed erc.missing_tie result). The same shape of limitation is disclosed for pfd_cp, see ../pfd-cp-layout/erc-supply-spec.json.
